### Summary of Requirements Document

* **Component:** [`RegulaFalsiSolver`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_50_group_b_arch/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/analysis/solvers/RegulaFalsiSolver.java)
* **Standard Algorithm Compliance:** The solver must strictly adhere to the standard Regula Falsi (False Position) root-finding algorithm without applying heuristic modifications or artificial interval alterations.
* **Evaluation Limits:** When convergence cannot be achieved within the caller-specified evaluation budget (`maxEval`), the solver must strictly enforce the budget and throw [`TooManyEvaluationsException`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_50_group_b_arch/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/exception/TooManyEvaluationsException.java).
* **Target Failure Case:** When solving $f(x) = \exp(x) - \pi^3$ on the interval $[1.0, 10.0]$ with default accuracies and a maximum evaluation count of 3,624, the solver must throw [`TooManyEvaluationsException`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_50_group_b_arch/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/exception/TooManyEvaluationsException.java) rather than returning an approximate root value.
